skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic Marxist-Leninist views on the working class and its historical mission.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Historical mission of the working class
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Grasp the historical mission of the working class in the context of modern society.
Comprehend the theoretical foundations of socialism and the transitional period towards socialism.
Recognize the nature of socialist democracy and the socialist state.
Understand the social structure, class alliances, and strata during the transition to socialism.
Analyze ethnic and religious issues during the transition to socialism.
Examine family-related issues during the transition to socialism.
Apply research methodologies to analyze historical missions and theoretical foundations.
Demonstrate ability to work independently and in groups.
Show capability for self-directed learning and study.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze political and social issues.
Collaborate effectively with peers in group activities.
Deliver presentations effectively, demonstrating understanding of course material.
